Use **`ppdv role remove`** from our toolkit (`node <plugin root>/scripts/ppdv.mjs role remove …`). It calls the Dataverse Web API bound action **`RemovePrivilegeRole`** on `roles(<id>)`, with the body `{"Privilege": {"@odata.type": "Microsoft.Dynamics.CRM.privilege", "privilegeid": "<id>"}}`.

- **Why not `/app-builder`:** it only edits roles it created. Its `roleGrants[]` can only add privileges, never remove them.
- **If the toolkit can't do it:** use the role designer in the maker portal.
